sections.name: Curiosities (part 2)
sections.title: Building each curiosity card
sections.what: For each curiosity, builds a card with a clickable plate, its code, status, year, role, thesis, idea text, and any linked projects.
sections.why: Linked projects appear only when they exist in the project data, so missing ones are skipped.
sections.watch_out: Cards alternate sides using the list position, so the order of the data affects the layout.

sections.name: Curiosities (part 3)
sections.title: Open questions and the full-note dialog
sections.what: Shows each card's open question, a button to read the full note, a numbered list of unlinked research questions, and the dialog that displays a full note.
sections.why: Questions already tied to a curiosity are left out of the bottom list so nothing repeats.
sections.watch_out: Clicks inside the dialog are stopped from closing it, while clicks outside or on Close do close it.

summary: Shows the list of current curiosities as cards. Each card opens a longer note in a dialog box.
purpose: The 'curiosities' section of the home page, plus a bottom list of open research questions.
why: Presents current interests and open questions in a readable way, with a plain or technical wording switch.
how: Reads the curiosities and research threads data, builds one card per curiosity with its plate, text, linked projects, and open question, then adds the list of unlinked questions and the dialog for full notes.
inputs: Data from the curiosities and research files, the project lookup, the image data, and the current mode from the mode context.
outputs: A section of cards, a bottom list of numbered open questions, and a dialog showing the full note.
risks: Cards alternate sides based on list order, so reordering the data changes the layout. Mode text is split into paragraphs on blank lines.
debug: If a card is missing its linked projects, check that the project slug exists in the project data. If a thread is shown twice or never shown, check the linking of curiosities to threads. If the dialog will not close, check the Escape key listener and the click handling.
